## Problem and result

Task: WP__ (owner chosen in team.json). Explain the change and resulting behaviour.

## Scientific evidence

Equations/assumptions checked; config/run/seed links; figures/tables and limitations. Distinguish measured results from expected behaviour. List core items completed and any deferred extras.

## Validation

Exact commands and observed results. Note checks not run and why. Link the reproduction manifest. One non-author must rerun the key command.

Map each completed core acceptance item to named tests or recorded experiments using [the evidence table](https://github.com/devam2006/mm-allee-harvesting/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md#required-evidence-for-every-task). Explain independent expectations, numerical tolerances and remaining gaps. Leave unsupported task items unchecked.

## Handoff checklist

- [ ] Code, meaningful tests, config and reproduction instructions included.
- [ ] Completed core acceptance items mapped to independent tests/experiments, with actual results and limitations.
- [ ] Owned report and notebook section updated; figures exported PNG + EPS.
- [ ] Shared interface changes documented and consumer owners informed.
- [ ] AI use, references, synthetic-data labels and limitations updated.
- [ ] No environment, secret, raw bulk output or model weight committed.
- [ ] All four other roster members requested in **Reviewers**; author assigned to self.
- [ ] Wait for all four current human approvals, green CI and resolved comments; non-author human merges.
